_comment: The frozen set. Declared BEFORE any lesson was induced, which is the only thing that
makes it a gate rather than a rationalisation.
Every assertion here was verified by hand against the live CMS and CA registries on
2026-07-28 -- see docs/REASONING.md for how each was established. The two ACO
false-positive cases are real defects found by running the pipeline, not planted.
target metric  : aco_precision  (we are trying to stop over-reporting affiliations)
guardrail      : aco_recall     (must not fall -- a precise matcher that finds nothing is worthless)
guardrail      : beds_coverage  (the registry spine must not regress while we tune the join)

expect_aco.why: CMS provider legal_business_name 'BRISTOL BAY HOLDINGS LLC' appears verbatim as an Aff_LBN in the MSSP PY2026 affiliate file. Two CMS files agreeing on a CMS-assigned string.

forbid_aco.why: Licensee is 'SOLETA HOLDINGS, INC.'; the matched affiliate is 'VIOLET HOLDINGS, LLC'. Different companies. The shared generic token 'holdings' inflated token_sort_ratio to 0.867.

expect_aco.why: legal_business_name '1527 SPRINGS ROAD LLC' is an exact Aff_LBN. Note the building name alone scores only 0.65 against it -- this match is only reachable via the legal-entity key.
legal_business_name 'HEARTWOOD AVENUE LLC' is an exact Aff_LBN.

forbid_aco.why: Matched 'SUNSHINE HEALTH FACILITIES, INC' at 1.000 under the original over-aggressive normalizer, which stripped both names to the single common token 'sunshine'.
Matched 'ALLIED SERVICES INSTITUTE OF REHABILITATION MEDICINE' at 0.923 under partial_ratio on a 7-character key.
